one_line: Maitraka ruler of Valabhi facing early Umayyad coastal raids and frontier pressures in western India.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, medium height, wiry but regal build
appearance.face: oval face with defined jaw, wheatish Gujarat complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short beard along jawline, sharp observant eyes with a calm, calculating default expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair, medium length, parted in the middle and combed back to just touch the nape; topped with a modest golden-brown cloth turban (paghdi) wrapped low with a small central jewel and a short folded tail over the left side
appearance.costume: long-sleeved fitted tunic (angarkha) in deep maroon cotton, crossed and tied to the right with two visible knotted cords, worn over a cream-colored close-neck inner shirt; ankle-length dhoti-style lower garment in muted saffron with a broad dark green border and simple geometric motifs, pleated in front and wrapped securely; around his shoulders a rich dark green woolen shawl with narrow gold edging draped over the left shoulder and tucked at the right hip; simple leather belt in dark brown holding a small pouch; jewelry restricted to a pair of small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold neck torque, and a single broad copper bracelet on his right wrist; leather sandals with thong straps, fully covering the feet.
appearance.signature: a straight-edged Indian sword (early khanda-like) with a slightly broad blade, iron hilt with a simple disc pommel and minimal hand-guard, housed in a plain dark brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings, worn at his left hip with his right hand often resting lightly on the grip.

ref_desc: Siladitya IV is a wiry, wheatish-complexioned ruler with a maroon angarkha, saffron dhoti, dark green shawl, modest golden-brown turban, small gold jewelry and a plain dark brown-scabbarded straight sword at his left hip in a maroon, cream, saffron and dark green palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Siladitya IV: an early-30s, medium-height, wiry Maitraka ruler with an oval wheatish face, straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short beard, and calm, observant eyes. His thick black hair is medium length, parted in the middle and combed back, covered by a modest golden-brown cloth turban wrapped low with a small central jewel and a short folded tail over the left side. He wears a deep maroon long-sleeved angarkha crossed and tied to the right over a cream close-neck inner shirt, and an ankle-length saffron dhoti-style lower garment with a dark green bordered hem and simple geometric motifs, pleated in front and wrapped securely. A dark green woolen shawl with narrow gold edging is draped over his left shoulder and tucked at the right hip, and a dark brown leather belt with a small pouch encircles his waist. His jewelry is minimal: small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold neck torque, and a single broad copper bracelet on his right wrist; his feet are covered with dark brown leather thong-strap sandals. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon, a straight-edged Indian sword with a slightly broad blade and iron hilt with disc pommel, in a plain dark brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings, his right hand often resting on the grip. Show him in neutral full-body poses that clearly present his face, hair, turban, angarkha, dhoti, shawl, sandals, sword and the maroon, cream, saffron, dark green and dark brown color scheme.
